meta.title: After-Sales Service & Support | WashThru
meta.description: See WashThru's after-sales commitments — 2-year warranty, multilingual support, spare parts availability, and our Basic, Remote Maintenance, Wash Cloud, and Full service plans.

items.lead: 2 years warranty for the machine against all manufacturing defects and malfunctions
We guarantee that maintenance and technical support services are provided in multiple languages
We guarantee that the required training is provided to partners on how to operate and periodically maintain the machines
We guarantee that all main and consumable spare parts are always provided and made available.
We guarantee our maximum cost calculation per vehicle.
items.rest: With our leading expertise in the car wash industry, we guarantee our partners that we calculate expenses and depreciation by calculating the life span of each part of the machine, with the possibility of providing a depreciation study per vehicle.

features.detail: Saving all historical data of the machines and reviewing: number of vehicles, vehicle entry time, vehicle size, and number of invoices issued via the system in case of subscription to the KOSOOR Platform. All done wirelessly from anywhere over a Wi-Fi network.

It is an interface that displays the life span of the wearable parts of the machines and launches alerts via the system when their lifespan limit approaches, so the partner can order and store such parts in advance and replace them on time or request the maintenance team to replace them on the earliest visit.

The machines are fully connected to WashThru systems to increase the levels of control, monitoring and quality of maintenance operations — reviewing the historical status of replaced parts, invoices, maintenance tickets, and tracking maintenance orders and visit reviews.

The central system accesses the machines and suggests the spare parts to be replaced in case of malfunction or depreciation. With this service, the partner can explore and directly order the spare parts and their alternatives, without the need to contact the company or search on the website.

Because we aim to help our partners remotely, we provide hundreds of maintenance session videos which enable the machine operator or technician on site to know exactly what to do in an easy visual method.
When the case requires remote live support, we provide special augmented-reality-based video tools which help guide the operator to do the right thing in the shortest time.

It is a super smart system that functions if there are problems not identified directly. This system puts forward all the possibilities received within a few seconds, and issues a full report on the machine, so the user can figure out the root causes of malfunctions without a site visit.

RND management constantly update the machines' OS, in order to increase the safety level, improve performance and quality, and add other features. This service contributes to updating the machines' OS continuously.
When human interventions are needed for repairs, this system displays solutions via videos, so that technicians or operators can know the required spare part and review the ideal repair method.

Our central system uses several AI tools, which read performance processes of non-wearable parts, collecting information related to their life span based on historical records, as well as other parameters, including the region, temperatures, humidity, and salinity.

It is a supplemental service for partners who have their own software, apps, or ERP systems and wish to connect them to the machine's systems. This technology allocates solutions based on the needs of partners for nominal fees, with no additional devices needed.

Wash-Cloud System features the ability to automatically report any malfunction without the need for any manual reporting procedure. Once reported, the maintenance staff handle the malfunction based on severity.

The ability to access the machines' systems for several basic and premium features using any electronic device (mobile or tablet) at anytime and anywhere around the world, while maintaining the highest safety standards without being present on the location of the machine.
It provides the ability to store and review all historical data of machines at anytime and anywhere, which protects such data from loss.
Receiving SMS alerts, especially in case of malfunction or when the part lifespan is approached.
Technical trips from our specialized technicians to perform all needed frequent maintenance and needed part replacements.

As long as the client continues receiving periodic maintenance services during the warranty period, and complies with warranty policies, the client can extend the warranty for an annual fee, up to 5 years.
